name: Handle With Care..
source:
Our hero was the vocalist of the legendary rock band "Bloody Roses." Presently, his activities with the band are on hold. At one of the live houses he played at, he met an extremely talented vocalist named Sahara Shion. He takes it upon himself to help her in her career... As a player, it is your goal to eventually bring this beautiful talent on stage at the live house "Moon Rouge." 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020815142849fw_/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ha/handle_with_care/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
translation:
主人公曾是传奇摇滚乐队“Bloody Roses”的主唱，目前乐队活动已经暂停。他在曾经登台的一家Live House里，遇见极富歌唱天赋的主唱佐原紫苑，并主动决定帮助她发展事业。玩家的目标，是最终让这位美丽新星登上Live House“Moon Rouge”的舞台。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020815142849fw_/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ha/handle_with_care/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
